purpose: Root applies reviewed issue refinements and transfers generated blockers before research closure; these proposals do not implement features.

refinements.title: Extract typed effect-safe runtime entrypoints and unified CLI dispatch
refinements.outcome: One thin installed ochat entrypoint selects validated command plans before runtime initialization, and reusable handlers return typed outcomes.
refinements.scope: Extract daemon, TUI and session stdio entrypoints into existing runtime/service libraries; map the selected command hierarchy and beta utility disposition. No new executor, GUI dependency or required deprecated MCP host.
acceptance: Help/version and parser errors work with absent or unreadable defaults before credential resolution, source capture, store/listener/terminal setup; inspect source-local and transitive module/native startup effects, including provider environment capture and daemon RNG. Filesystem-only probes do not establish the whole guarantee.

Pure validated plans distinguish local/connect, host configuration and execution settings; preserve absent/null/value and host-owned credential identity. No flat TUI argv configuration is injected into other commands.
Handlers receive explicit Eio capabilities and do not call exit; the executable maps each outcome once. No GUI initialization/dependency for CLI/service/help.
Internal helper selection precedes unrelated command initialization while preserving inherited-channel authentication; OCH-111 qualifies the actual confined artifact.
Current utility workflows remain usable during explicit beta mappings; deprecated MCP host has a separate disposition, not a newly required product server.

refinements.title: Qualify internal agent-helper dispatch in the actual unified installed artifact
refinements.outcome: The final ochat internal agent-helper artifact preserves current scoped authority and confined execution.
refinements.scope: Change exact helper argv/digest registration and dispatch without expanding roots, environment, network or credentials.
acceptance: Execute the final installed artifact under the current compiled grant with exact canonical path, digest and argv; do not substitute only the legacy small helper for this acceptance.
Preserve fd 3/4 FIFO checks, bounded framing and request/response counts, scope expiry, revocation before disclosure, cancellation/reaping, descriptor/environment isolation and resource ceilings.
No config/help/host/terminal chatter or socket/token/credential fallback. Request data cannot select a privileged mode or supply authority.
Investigate transitive linked initialization under confinement; never broaden permissions merely to make the larger artifact start.
If the unified artifact cannot satisfy confinement, retain only a qualified private helper temporarily and mark this migration incomplete with a concrete remaining blocker.

refinements.title: Implement bounded single-turn and ChatML-owned workflow headless observers
refinements.outcome: Headless runs report host-committed state and explicit uncertainty without inventing a CLI continuation loop.
refinements.scope: Use shared run receipts and the existing session/client actor; CAP-R4 owns authored continue/wait/finish composition.
acceptance: Single-turn admits one root user operation including its tool/provider followups; later authored workflow turns are not silently absorbed. Exactly one message/file/stdin source is required only when submitting user input.

Workflow requires a qualified ChatMD orchestrator. Explicit no-input orchestration start validates startup policy and supports existing/fresh scheduled sessions without synthesizing empty user messages; CLI idleness never triggers an automatic continue prompt.
JSON/JSONL output is bounded and versioned with stdout purity, stable sequence/run/session identities and one terminal/client outcome. Provider SSE is not the public command schema.
EOF, output failure and signals apply ownership-specific detach/cancel/cleanup; receipt loss is uncertain until reconciliation, not failure or automatic resubmission.

Finish waits for settled or authorized relinquished owned work, commits a terminal receipt and leaves session liveness independent; unrelated jobs do not block completion. Permissions and limits remain host-enforced.

refinements.title: Complete installed executable inventory and explicit beta CLI cutover
refinements.outcome: The installed product surface has one ochat command with documented migrations and no accidental duplicate public runtime parser.
refinements.scope: Inventory installed/developer-only/retired executables and resource packaging. Cut over only qualified workflows and confined helper artifact.
acceptance: Map chat-tui, ochat-agent-server and ochat-agent-stdio flags/workflows into unified commands with actionable errors and examples; qualify equivalent process/output ownership first.
Test the installed artifact and manifest, not only build-tree executables; CLI/help/service commands do not load GUI runtime or require desktop completion.
Retire the public helper only after OCH-111 artifact qualification. A temporary private helper is an explicit incomplete migration, not a widened grant.
Keep useful utility commands deliberately. Deprecated MCP prompt host disposition is reviewed separately from maintained MCP tools and is not newly required.
No frozen legacy storage reader is implied by executable migration; universal document conversion requirements remain owned by their existing tasks.

generated_tasks.title: Commit and expose shared host-owned run lifecycle and terminal receipts
generated_tasks.body:
Add a narrow shared runtime-host run record spanning one or more existing operations, with distinct run/session/generation/operation/request identities and authoritative terminal receipts. Reuse the session actor, durable invocation/operation receipts, local persistence and current event/client projections. This is the host state and admission seam; CAP-R4 retains reusable ChatML lifecycle policy and action composition. Do not build a second executor or scheduler.

Admission validates captured definition, expected session generation, current authority, liveness/ownership and explicit single-turn versus workflow scope. Support either submitted user input or an authorized no-input authored orchestration start. Commit admission identity before effects; same-scope retry returns the original receipt, conflicting idempotency reuse rejects. Track owned work and intent relationships. Continue/wait use existing scheduling and receipts; wait records its authorized wake condition. Finish commits completed/failed/cancelled/limited/interrupted state only after owned work settles or is explicitly relinquished under authority. Run completion must not stop its session or wait for unrelated jobs.

Expose authorization-checked read/subscription and terminal result references. Commit terminal state before notification; identical terminal retries are no-ops and conflicting terminal transitions reject. Loss of a connection or receipt is a client uncertainty, not an inferred host terminal state. Restore/reconnect rebuilds committed local state and event sequence before further effects, with no silent model/tool replay. Transient process lifetime and durable-host guarantees remain explicit.

Acceptance uses actor-level meaningful tests for terminal commit/retry conflicts, same-request admission, receipt-loss reconciliation, reconnect/restart, scope expiry/cancellation, owned versus unrelated work and successful finish with a live session. Add universal-document codecs with absent/null/value behavior and no provider tokens/remote hosted state. Coordinate exact storage and lifecycle interfaces with OCH-51/OCH-52 and OCH-88; unblock OCH-112 with this concrete host contract rather than whole milestone gates.

proposed_prerequisites.reason: Reuse shared session actor/service contract; refine only the missing run projection.
Lifecycle continue/wait/finish policy and host action integration; no duplicate policy owner.
Use shared local document persistence/codec contract where required by implementation.
Use accepted universal-document absent/null/value conversions where required by implementation.

proposed_dependency_changes.reason: Headless observers require authoritative run admission/terminal receipts and uncertainty/reconnect semantics.

ownership_constraints: OCH-88/CAP-R4 owns ChatMD-native tools, builtin docs and reusable ChatML lifecycle composition.
Reuse existing jobs/timers/schedules and session actor; generated run record is not a second executor.
No GUI or desktop milestone dependency for ordinary CLI/runtime delivery; explicit desktop gates remain unchanged.
Root owns final ticket/dependency mutations; proposed prerequisites are narrow contract joins, not broad milestone start bans.
